mapper.sql: id, code, sales_user_id, sales_user_phone, status, created_by_user_id, create_time, update_time
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_sales_redemption_code SET code = #{code}, sales_user_id = #{salesUserId}, sales_user_phone = #{salesUserPhone}, status = #{status}, created_by_user_id = #{createdByUserId}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ai_sales_redemption_code WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM ai_sales_redemption_code WHERE code = #{code} LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM ai_sales_redemption_code WHERE sales_user_id = #{salesUserId} LIMIT 1

SELECT src.id, src.code, src.sales_user_id AS salesUserId, COALESCE(u.nickname, u.username, src.sales_user_id) AS salesUserName, src.sales_user_phone AS salesUserPhone, sup.receipt_code_url AS receiptCodeUrl, sup.receipt_code_object_key AS receiptCodeObjectKey, src.create_time AS createTime FROM ai_sales_redemption_code src LEFT JOIN ai_user u ON u.user_id = src.sales_user_id LEFT JOIN ai_sales_user_profile sup ON sup.user_id = src.sales_user_id WHERE src.status = 1
AND ( src.code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR src.sales_user_phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR COALESCE(u.nickname, u.username, src.sales_user_id) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
ORDER BY src.id DESC
